fact: On 16 February 2024 the transition's vice-prime minister handed the consortium Tich Consulting - Gladius - BS Gabon the World Bank-financed contract to supply a turnkey health information system including an electronic medical record module, the health minister stating that 23 health facilities are to be connected as pilot sites, 10 by fibre and 13 by radio link.
title: eGabon SIS : vers un hôpital sans papier
